format: Studio / Custom events: dance role is not gender; future gender-data evaluation
requirement: DanceFlow policy: dance role (leader/follower) and gender are separate concepts. Gender is never inferred from dance role, name, or unrelated profile data. No universal gender collection. Any future gender-data collection is a SEPARATE privacy and data-minimization decision evaluated against the checklist in the OD-27 record (purpose, necessity, access controls, retention, verification, participant disclosures).
interpretation_notes: Policy statement for product and engineering; carries no compliance claim. Related: OD-02/OD-03 age handling and OD-18/OD-19 relabelling in sibling PRs were not re-read here.
decision_refs: OD-27 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B retain Studio/Custom role flexibility; document body limitations; retrospective audit PR #795)
